accepted_context_decisions: Modern neutral Thai teacher register without gendered particles.
ขึ้น/ลง remain neutral for both melodic contour and physical picking direction; bare ordinal intervals and named fingers remain distinct.
ท่อนบริดจ์ is song form; หย่อง is instrument hardware. คอร์ดเมเจอร์และไมเนอร์รอบตัว and คู่เสียงเมเจอร์และไมเนอร์ are current source-bound separate senses.
One beat remains duration/count/missing-beat compatible. Bar/measure synonym quiz consistently introduces the transliterated English synonyms, with Thai Beat/Rest choices.
The later lesson-author glossary decisions supersede duplicate legacy glossary entries such as คู่แปด versus อ็อกเทฟ.

All original-song titles and their lesson/body/quiz uses were checked. Ghost Light as แสงภูต is accepted within the supplied original-song context, which does not establish the technical theatre-lamp sense.
Historical centuries preserve literal 1700/1800 digits and explicitly say the full hundred-year span; source decades retain decade sense.
All 51 nested arrangement section labels were separately inspected against their exact roles, not inferred solely from title/credit bundles.
counting_convention: and is และ in both eighth- and sixteenth-note Thai counting; e/a remain อี/อะ. Rock and roll stays ร็อกแอนด์โรล.
